messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from the side. Use the provided camera reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described side full-body camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use video 0 as the starting point and apply the following edit to it: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from the side. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands in profile, then bends forward at the waist, hugging his knees with his arms, and slowly straightens back up to a standing position.","camera":"A static, full-body side profile shot at eye level.","clothing":"A light blue, open-knit sweater over a white shirt, light blue jeans, tan socks, and brown lace-up shoes.","hair_color":"Light brown / dark blond.","hairstyle":"Short, cropped hair, neatly styled.","identity":"A slim, light-skinned young man with a short, neat haircut, shown in profile.","scene":"An outdoor urban rooftop or alley with a large gray metal container, cobblestone and tiled ground, and city buildings in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the same man in a full-body side profile, standing in front of a large gray metal container in an urban rooftop/alley setting. The framing matches the reference at the start, and the action progresses from standing to bending forward and hugging his knees, then straightening up.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a static full-body side shot matching the reference's viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, clothing, action timing, and scene.
unexpected_changes: The scene background changed from the original street with storefronts and cranes to a different urban rooftop/alley with a large gray container, although the subject's clothing and general environment style remain similar.
